text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Dorm Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome back, Duramente!
Out running since morning again? Good on you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No. It's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Dorm Staff
text_block_list.text:
"My. The girls at this academy really are all so wonderful.
Ah, that reminds me..."

text_block_list.name: Dorm Staff
text_block_list.text:
A package arrived for you, Duramente-san.
—It's from your father!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: From Father...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(—What was delivered to me
was a single, worn-out notebook.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Inside, there was also
a letter from my father...)

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't want to burden you with anything heavier
than what you already bear, pushing yourself so hard.
With that in mind, I now present what I've held back."

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text: "With how you are now, you will be fine. Please, unravel our family's history from a different perspective. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text: "I believe with all my heart that those feelings will become your strength."
(Flip...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (The original seems to be in French. But someone translated it and added notes later, it looks like.)

text_block_list.name: Memoir
text_block_list.text:
...Even here in this Far Eastern country, far removed from France, races were held.
Yet, they still fell far short of world-class standards.

text_block_list.name: Memoir
text_block_list.text:
"Bring Japanese racing to the world."
I will answer the passion of those who invited me to this land and fulfill my duty as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Memoir
text_block_list.text:
To ensure I wouldn't forget that resolve, I decided to keep a daily log in my notebook.
...Because it seemed this was going to be a long fight.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(—A long struggle. The notebook truly chronicled
his long, arduous battle.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Starting from building a training facility,
preparing the environment, scrambling to gather talented Umamusume...
Taking on the world was the least of their worries back then.)

text_block_list.name: Memoir
text_block_list.text:
“—Just as I was about to give up,
I met an Umamusume.”

text_block_list.name: Memoir
text_block_list.text:
I understood instinctively. Her hidden talent... that beautiful running of hers would surely blossom one day.
I immediately made a vow to her.

text_block_list.name: Memoir
text_block_list.text:
—The you that I found promised...
'I will prove without a doubt that you are the strongest.'
It's a contract.
"I will without fail prove that Duramente is the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
It had already begun a long time ago, hadn't it."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Yet his vow went unfulfilled.
The Umamusume he met retired before ever blooming,
never even getting to see the world...)
(Flip...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
This is......—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —The notebook... it kept going.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Their children carried on their feelings...
and continued to write, aiming for the world.
choice_data_list: To think something like that exists...

text_block_list.text:
One day after training,
Duramente surprisingly invited me for a walk...
and talked about her clan's notebook.
choice_data_list: Could it be... your father as well?
Could it be... your father as well?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Grandfather, and Father too...
Every one of them left their feelings in this notebook.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There was hard work. There was agony.
There were challenges. There was defeat...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And—in the end, without fail,
there was always hope.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hope for... the future...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought being strong was all that mattered.
That that was what made you the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However...
perhaps that isn't the case.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...'—The challenge never ends.
Hopes turn to aspirations, linked forever through blood.'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"It may be a wish that cannot come true right now.
Yet surely, someone will inherit my feelings.
And when that happens—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "My beloved, too, will see the world one day."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...'The dream of everyone in this country
who wished to take on the world—'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Someday, it will definitely come true!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That "someday"—is now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I... want to answer their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The past. The prayers. The expectations. The wishes...
I want to carry their hope on my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It's not just my family. It's the feelings of everyone who loves racing... everyone who led to "me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: “—Shouldering it all, I want to become the best in the world!”

An intense light surged in her eyes.
Her resolve, her determination, burned fiercely within them.
If she carries it all on her shoulders, I want to be the one to support her. Those words welled up naturally, backed by a resolve far deeper than when I first spoke them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: Let's prove to the world that you're the strongest.
Let's prove that you're the strongest in the world.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Ah!
